title: Strategic Account Roadmap Co-authoring Protocol & Commitment Forecast
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective:
Define a lightweight, repeatable protocol that converts strategic-account signals (renewal risk, executive escalations, contract milestones) into a co-authored short-term roadmap and a transparent commitment forecast for Sales/CS and Engineering leadership.

Background:
Top-account asks often arrive as high-context escalation threads with different expectations across Sales, CS, and Product. Current intake patterns lead to unclear commitments, last-minute scope changes, and ad-hoc prioritization that undermines trust with customers and creates downstream engineering churn. This ticket creates a formal co-authoring workflow: a short intake form, a triage scoring rubric, a timeboxed co-author session, and a commitment forecast ledger that captures agreed scope, owner, and rollback/fallback options.

Scope (in-scope):
- Intake form template for AEs/CS to submit strategic asks (fields: impact, contract clause, timeline, exec sponsor, measurable success criteria).
- Triage scoring rubric (technical feasibility, customer revenue at risk, time-to-value, strategic visibility).
- 30- to 60-minute co-authoring sessions between PM, Eng lead, CS AE to convert accepted asks into a minimally scoped deliverable + contingency plan.
- Commitment forecast ledger that records: agreed deliverable, committed window, confidence level, rollback policy, and communication owner.
- Integration hooks: link to Customer 360 dashboard and a canonical PR/Confluence spec.

Out of scope:
- Changes to billing or discounting processes.
- Automated enforcement of commitments (this is a human-run protocol initially).

Success metrics:
- Time from escalation intake to published commitment forecast <= 7 business days (target 3 days).
- >70% of strategic intake items have an assigned PM and Eng owner within 48 hours.
- Reduction in post-commitment scope changes by 40% for participating accounts within Q2 pilot.
- Sales/CS NPS for intake experience >= +30 in pilot group.

Approach & deliverables:
1) Intake form (Confluence template + short form link) and one-pager guidance for AEs/CS.
2) Triage rubric document with scoring thresholds and example calibrations.
3) Co-authoring session template (agenda, decision record, fallback options).
4) Commitment forecast ledger (Google Sheet prototype) and a plan to populate Console summary card for customer-facing stakeholders.
5) Pilot with 5 strategic accounts during Cycle 11, capture metrics and iterate.

Stakeholders:
- PM lead: Ava Martinez (creator)
- Assigned PM: Liam O'Connor (assignee)
- Eng lead (pilot): Priya Singh
- Sales lead sponsor: Daniel Reed
- CS sponsor: Maya Chen
- Legal advisory: Anika Patel

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake form live and documented with examples.
- Triage rubric accepted by PM, Eng, and Sales leads and used in 3 pilot cases.
- Commitment ledger populated for pilot cases and accessible to Sales/CS.
- Two retrospective sessions completed with action items for iteration.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Over-committing to scope => Mitigation: require explicit rollback/fallback recorded in ledger and a confidence level.
- Risk: Sales skips protocol under pressure => Mitigation: executive sponsor alignment and incentive in pilot charter.
- Risk: Engineering capacity mismatch => Mitigation: mandate Eng lead presence in co-author session and score threshold for auto-reject.

Timeline (high-level):
- Week 0-1: Align stakeholders, finalize intake form and rubric.
- Week 2: Run first co-authoring sessions with two pilot accounts.
- Week 3-5: Iterate, expand to additional accounts, start populating ledger.
- Week 6: Pilot retrospective and decision whether to scale.

Rollout plan:
- Pilot (5 accounts) for 6 weeks. If success metrics met, scale playbook to 2 additional Sales pods in Q2. Integrate ledger into Redwood Console summary card by roadmap-2026.Q2 release.
